title: executive-daily-priorities-harini-2026-03-05
content:
Morning brain dump - 2026-03-05

Top goals this week (week of Mar 2-6)
- Finalize Dedicated contract terms for AcmeCorp by EOD Thu (legal + finance review). Need updated SLO language + pricing floor.
- Greenlight Canary plan for model-rollout v1.4 (Hosted API): confirm A/B metrics and rollback thresholds.
- Align SRE + infra on priority hotspots: 95p latency spikes on long-tail comp requests (>=2k tokens).
- Quick decision on private deployment timeline for RegulaBank (P0). Can we shift a node from staging pool?

Today - must-do (top 3)
1) 9:00-9:30 sync w/ Sofia (CEO) – talking points: AcmeCorp contract, Private pilot timeline, exec comms. Bring short slide (2) on risk/mitigation.
   - Prep: one pager with pricing cliff + recommended concession window.
2) 11:00 cross-functional review: Canary metrics for v1.4 (product + serving-runtime + observability)
   - Ask: define primary metric = tokens/sec at p50/p95 + quality regression threshold (BLEU-ish / eval set).
   - If QA flag present > 2% regressions on eval prompt set -> pause rollout.
3) 16:00 Finance check-in re: Dedicated ARR recognition and revised payment terms for AcmeCorp.

Secondary / nice-to-have
- Review SRE incident postmortem (Mar 1 spike) and add two suggested infra changes to backlog.
- Quick read: Redwood Optimize initial quantization results (2 pager from research). Skim for high-level recommendation.
- Draft short note to sales on new canary rollout process (template + who to loop in).

Open questions / unknowns
- Does legal accept the proposed data residency clause for RegulaBank? If not, escalate to Amy.
- Capacity: can platform allocate 1x A100 equivalent from dedicated pool for private pilot starting 3/16? Need platform confirmation by Thu.
- Cost modeling: what is unit token cost delta between current quantized build and hardware-optimized build? Ask infra/research.

Follow-ups from yesterday
- Maya: send final list of eval prompts for v1.4 -> waiting (Maya said EOD yesterday).
- Infra: noted affinity rules change in k8s cluster -> need clarification on autoscaler behavior during burst.
- Legal: draft of customer-facing SLA under review (left comments 3/4).

Meeting prep notes
- 9:00 w/ Sofia: 2 slides + one-pager (risk table) + ask: approval to offer 6 month discounted pilot to AcmeCorp (up to $Xk). Have fallback: 3-month with stricter caps.
- 11:00 Canary review: bring example trace (p95 latency spike) and a short runbook for rollback. Confirm monitoring alerts (pager on p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m).
- 14:30 SRE deep-dive: bring error budget burn chart and top 3 services by error rate.

Quick reminders / TODOs
- Send invite to product-hosted-api owners for rollout dry-run (block 2 hrs next Tue).
- Update confluence page: /confluence/redwood/canary-playbook (add rollback bullets).
- Ping solutions-eng about storage encryption for private deployments (need final doc).

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep the ask simple for Sofia: decision today enables sales motion; delays push timeline by 2 weeks.
- Use concrete numbers in exec comms (ARR, expected adoption %, unit economics).
- Avoid deep technical details in the first slide - put in appendix.

Snippets / snippets to copy into comms
- "Recommend offering a constrained 6-month pilot with a usage cap and price floor; roll to standard pricing after pilot if performance/uptime targets met."
- "Primary rollout metric: no more than 2% quality regression on eval set and p95 latency within 1.5x of baseline for >=95% of traffic."

Later items (this week)
- Thu: confirm private deploy node allocation + legal signoff (RegulaBank).
- Fri: executive update draft + metrics snapshot for board readout.

Mental model / risk register (short)
- Risk: Acme asks for steep discounts -> Mitigation: tie discount to SLA metrics and reduced support window.
- Risk: Canary uncovers quality regression -> Mitigation: immediate rollback + block inbound traffic to canary + notify customers.

Links / refs (copy into calendar invite)
- JIRA: JIRA-OPS-842 (canary rollout pipeline)
- Confluence: CON-1234 (canary playbook draft)
- Slack: #exec-all, #sre-incident

End of scratchpad. Will update after 9:00 sync.

-- HM
